title: Build composable, interoperable multi-agent systems with A2A on AWS
summary: Build a composable, interoperable multi-agent system on AWS with the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. A LangChain orchestrator on Amazon ECS communicates with a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore across organizational boundaries, using bidirectional, OAuth-authenticated call
reason: Technical how-to blog on composing multi-agent systems with the A2A protocol using existing tools (LangChain, Strands, Bedrock AgentCore). It announces no new model, research artifact, business event, policy action, or new open-source tool/framework release.
